assessment: De la Concepcion and colleagues investigated the mode of co-evolution of plant immune receptor pair that functions as a unit to detect pathogen invasion and turn on immunity. The study shows that an allelic mismatch of a receptor pair from rice can cause autoimmunity in the absence of pathogen effectors, and this can be traced to polymorphisms that arose fairly recently. Overall the study supports that the paired receptors have coevolved to prevent premature inactivation.
